summary.text: Michael Kripchak is the Democratic candidate for Ohio State Senate District 33 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a U.S. Air Force Academy graduate who served in the Air Force from 2000 to 2007.

paragraphs.text: Michael Kripchak was born in Youngstown, Ohio.
He served in the U.S. Air Force from 2000 to 2007 and earned a bachelor's degree from the United States Air Force Academy in 2004.
He later earned a graduate degree from New York University's Tisch School of the Arts in 2018.
